correctness.rationale: For every mixed binary word v of length m and every L>=m+1 and n<2^(L-m), padding binary n with >=m zeros preserves overlapping occurrences of v. Bitwise complement turns its L-bit padded representation into the ordinary binary representation of y=2^L-1-n; prepending prescribed initial zeros for complement pattern adds exactly delta(complement(v)) occurrences independent of n, where delta is one only for 0^a1^(m-a), 1<=a<m. Thus exact integral count identity e_barv(y)=e_v(n)+delta(barv). For each arbitrary finite monochromatic arithmetic progression of difference d, choose L large and reverse its members under y=2^L-1-x; reflected sequence has same common difference and colors shifted by the same parity. Converse by complement proves equal suprema A_v(d)=A_barv(d) for every d>=1, including infinite suprema. Independent direct occurrence counts for mixed lengths 2..6 and several starts/steps corroborated exact identities; the arbitrary-length reflection argument proves the full claim.
